findings.issue: The TDD Anchor names tests/e2e/core.spec.ts as the task's only regression anchor and asserts «It exercises both display sites this task rewrites: `.tm-group-header__counter` alongside the title in the normal header … if this suite goes red, the fallback path is wrong.» Verified against the file: core.spec.ts contains no reference to `__title`, no `getByText`, and no occurrence of 'Focus' or 'In Progress'. Normal groups are located by `.tm-task-group:has([data-group-id="…"])` plus `.tm-group-header__counter` (lines 41, 53, 267, 279, 292) — the counter is not the title, and no assertion depends on the rendered name. The only name-dependent locator is `.tm-collapsible-group__header` filtered by `hasText: 'Backlog'` (line 251), which covers CollapsibleGroup only. A broken fallback in GroupHeader.svelte or GroupSettingsPopup.svelte would leave the suite green, so the stated guarantee does not hold for two of the three rewritten sites.
findings.fix: Scope the claim: state that core.spec.ts covers the collapsible-group title only (via `hasText: 'Backlog'`), and that GroupHeader and GroupSettingsPopup fallbacks are covered by the manual read-through step already listed in Verification Steps — or add an explicit assertion for a normal-header title to the anchor.

findings.issue: The Dependencies section justifies leaving Task 02 out of `depends_on` because promoting it «would serialize wave 2 behind wave 1». findings.fix: Either delete the rationale sentence and keep a one-line note («Task 02 lands in wave 1, so tsc is clean by then»), or keep the caveat only as a fallback for out-of-order manual execution.
